import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
# check for duplicate rows per key on anomaly date vs baseline
key=['date','csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
print(d[d.date=='2025-10-13'].shape, d[d.date=='2025-10-13'].drop_duplicates(subset=key).shape)
# z-score of each row's cost vs its own history
hist = d.groupby(key+['price'], dropna=False)['unblended_cost'].agg(['mean','std'])
m = d.merge(hist, left_on=key+['price'], right_index=True)
m['z'] = (m.unblended_cost - m['mean'])/m['std']
print(m.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(10)[['date']+key+['num_instances','unblended_cost','z']])

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
# per-series stats excluding anomaly date
res=[]
for k,g in d.groupby(key):
    g=g.sort_values('date')
    base=g[g.date<'2025-10-13']['unblended_cost']
    if len(base)<5: continue
    mu,sd=base.mean(),base.std()
    for _,r in g[g.date>='2025-10-13'].iterrows():
        z=(r.unblended_cost-mu)/sd if sd>0 else np.inf
        res.append((k, r.date, r.num_instances, r.unblended_cost, mu, z))
res.sort(key=lambda x:-x[5] if np.isfinite(x[5]) else -1e9)
for r in res[:10]: print(r)

{"code": "import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
# check for duplicate rows per key on anomaly date vs baseline
key=['date','csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
print(d[d.date=='2025-10-13'].shape, d[d.date=='2025-10-13'].drop_duplicates(subset=key).shape)
# z-score of each row's cost vs its own history
hist = d.groupby(key+['price'], dropna=False)['unblended_cost'].agg(['mean','std'])
m = d.merge(hist, left_on=key+['price'], right_index=True)
m['z'] = (m.unblended_cost - m['mean'])/m['std']
print(m.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(10)[['date']+key+['num_instances','unblended_cost','z']])"}

{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
# per-series stats excluding anomaly date
res=[]
for k,g in d.groupby(key):
    g=g.sort_values('date')
    base=g[g.date<'2025-10-13']['unblended_cost']
    if len(base)<5: continue
    mu,sd=base.mean(),base.std()
    for _,r in g[g.date>='2025-10-13'].iterrows():
        z=(r.unblended_cost-mu)/sd if sd>0 else np.inf
        res.append((k, r.date, r.num_instances, r.unblended_cost, mu, z))
res.sort(key=lambda x:-x[5] if np.isfinite(x[5]) else -1e9)
for r in res[:10]: print(r)"}
